images.initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one production-quality desktop Fouc application screen, an actual usable software interface, Chinese text.
Primary request: Design the “依赖地图” page for the ADD-driven development work item “成员邀请与权限”. This is the Atlas direction: organize meaningful relationships, owners and evidence rather than ten pipeline stages. Create ONE complete screen, never a multi-screen collage, poster, presentation slide or browser mockup.
Input image 1 role: exact existing Fouc outer shell and normal UI density reference. Preserve its project switcher, main navigation, system title bar and bottom account controls. Replace ONLY the inner Dashboard content with the requested page; do not reproduce dashboard metrics.
Output framing: approximately 1600 × 1000 desktop viewport at normal 100% UI scale. Extend the content horizontally; DO NOT enlarge the reference UI to fill the image. The outer sidebar must occupy about 17% of frame width (roughly 260–272px), the top system bar about 44px. Body text 13px, secondary labels 12px, title 18–20px, buttons 30px, ordinary rows 34px. No huge headers, thick typography or spacious oversized controls.
Shell invariants: #f9f9f9 sidebar; project “Fouc 桌面端 V1” with the same tiny green-blue project avatar and collapse control. Navigation order “新对话”, “工作台” (active), “任务”, “成员”, “资产”, “智能体”; small divider; “频道” / “产品与设计”; “最近” below; at bottom “社区”, “连接器”, then “Fouc Admin” avatar / moon / settings. FA7 solid neutral gray icons like reference. System bar has history arrows, active page tab “成员邀请与权限”, plus, search, task icon, window controls. White main content below system bar has 16px outer corner radius, one light outline. No new branding, logo row, colored sidebar, thick separator or decorative illustration.
Inner page: exactly ONE compact 48px object toolbar, inline small relationship icon, title “成员邀请与权限”, small mode dropdown “依赖地图”, right quiet “影响范围” and black button “打开契约”. No breadcrumb, no extra tabs, no metadata header, no KPI row. Core content begins immediately around y=96.
Main workspace is a beautifully precise relationship map on a nearly-white surface with extremely subtle small dots, not an automation builder. Seven distinct compact object nodes, arranged in a considered branching composition with ample usable canvas and thin elegant connecting paths. They represent deliverables and proof, not sequential stages. At left: “需求与验收” with tiny file icon, “AC-01 · 管理员邀请” and green “已确认”; beneath it “特性边界” with “项目成员与邀请权限” and green “已确认”. Center: selected node “邀请契约 v3” with small blue selection line and amber “1 项待对齐”; above/adjacent “Web 邀请交互” with “src/features/project” and blue “进行中”; below/adjacent “服务端校验” with “backend/server” and green “局部验证通过”. Right side: “独立评审” with “Reviewer · 陈宁” and gray “待交接”; below “邀请全链路 E2E” with amber “等待契约确认”. Node typography is 13px body, 12px secondary, small semantic status dots. Nodes use thin clear boundaries and 8px corners, no heavy card shadow, no giant cards.
Map connections are semantic relationships, some labeled in tiny muted text: “依据”, “消费”, “实现”, “验证”. One selected dependency branch from invitation contract through Web implementation to E2E is a crisp restrained blue, other links pale gray; avoid tangled lines and excessive arrows. One small well-aligned “ADR-07 角色策略” text reference belongs beside the contract node, not a full extra panel.
A narrow inspector at the right, about 260px wide, aligned directly under the toolbar, white surface separated by ONE faint vertical line. Heading “邀请契约 v3”, tiny document subtitle “boundary.md · 已选中”. Compact grouped rows: “所有者” / “业务服务”, “消费者” / “Web 客户端”, “关联任务” / “T-06 邀请接口”. Below a carefully composed pale amber inline issue: “过期邀请的重发规则待确认”; small link “查看影响的 3 项工作”. Small lower section “引用依据” with two document links “需求与验收” and “ADR-07 角色策略”. Inspector is quiet and helpful, not a checklist dashboard.
Bottom-left of canvas has tiny map controls minus / “100%” / plus / fit-view, bottom-right small legend green “已确认” blue “进行中” amber “待对齐”. No full chat panel. Current date anchor 2026-11-12 if any date is shown; omit irrelevant dates.
Art direction: a top-tier professional studio's beautifully calibrated technical workspace. Refined typography, tight baseline rhythm, whisper-thin dividers, realistic content density, purposeful white space, editorial precision. Use black/white/grays for ordinary controls; semantic blue/amber/green only in meaningful content. All Chinese words legible and correct. Avoid repeated headings, nested cards, feature inventories, 10-stage progress bar, double tabs, huge empty top half, gradients or 3D decoration.

images.title: 契约与责任
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE realistic, exceptionally refined desktop Fouc software screen: “邀请契约与责任”. Chinese UI, approximately 1600×1000. No presentation board, collage or marketing page.
Reference image 1 is the existing Fouc shell, to be preserved. It is a wide desktop screenshot at normal small UI density. Preserve all outer chrome at native visual size, NOT proportionally enlarged: narrow light-gray sidebar occupying ONLY one sixth of the image, about 260px; system top bar 44px. The main white rounded work surface begins near x=272,y=44. This is a precision developer application with body and navigation at 13px, secondary 12px, title 18px, 30px buttons, 34px rows. Keep typography restrained and substantially smaller than typical dashboard mockups.
Exact shell: project switcher “Fouc 桌面端 V1” and existing green-blue avatar; nav “新对话”, “工作台” selected, “任务”, “成员”, “资产”, “智能体”; divider; “频道”/“产品与设计”, “最近”; bottom “社区”, “连接器”, “Fouc Admin”/moon/settings. Current neutral FA7 solid icon treatment. Top system bar history arrows, selected tab “邀请契约”, plus, search/task/window controls. #f9f9f9 shell, white work surface with 16px outer radius.
Inner page has only ONE slim toolbar, from y≈44 to≈92: small contract icon, “邀请契约”, tiny muted “v3 · 成员邀请与权限” on same line; right quiet “查看影响” and black “发起确认”. DO NOT create another page header, breadcrumb, tabs, metadata row, progress strip, metrics, big banner or second toolbar.
Below starts a confident continuous technical document composition. About 76% content width is the editable contract body, remaining 24% is a single narrow responsibility inspector separated by one thin line. No separate left sub-sidebar. Carefully aligned document with 44px inset and restrained paragraph width, not a centered giant card.
At top of document, small section label “契约范围”, then concise 13px prose “业务服务拥有邀请状态与权限校验；Web 客户端呈现邀请结果，不自行推断成员资格。” Two small source links on one line “boundary.md” and “ADR-07 · 角色策略”.
Next, a beautiful precise relationship strip with two flat outlined compact objects “业务服务 / 所有者” at left and “Web 客户端 / 消费者” at right, connected by a thin arrow labeled “InvitationResult”. It is a technical contract relationship, not a giant illustration.
Then “接口约定” with a dense professional table occupying the main area. Columns “操作” / “输入与结果” / “约束”. Four rows: “创建邀请” / “POST /invitations → pending” / “仅项目管理员”; “接受邀请” / “POST /invitations/:id/accept” / “有效期内，幂等加入”; “撤回邀请” / “DELETE /invitations/:id” / “未接受前可撤回”; “重发邀请” / “旧 token 失效，返回新链接” / amber small “待确认”. Table rows only 40–44px despite multiline descriptions, subtle header tint and faint separators, no card wrapper.
Below, “验收与责任” another compact 3-row mapping “AC-01 管理员发送邀请” / owner “业务服务” / proof “权限契约测试”; “AC-02 重复接受不重复加入” / owner “业务服务” / proof “幂等性测试”; “AC-03 过期链接可重新发送” / owner “Web + 业务服务” / amber “规则待定”. Keep real contents, fine alignment and sober type.
The right inspector begins directly below toolbar with small heading “待对齐 1”, a narrow amber side rule (not big warning card), question “邀请过期后，是否允许成员自行重发？”; two 13px choices as simple rows “仅管理员可重发” selected and “邀请接收者可请求重发” unselected. Small muted context “影响权限边界与异常提示”. A single fine divider. Section “参与确认” with two tiny avatar rows “林悦 · 产品负责人” and “陈宁 · 接口负责人”, each “待确认”; then small “关联影响” links “T-06 邀请接口”, “Web 邀请异常提示”, “邀请全链路 E2E”. At bottom a small text link “返回依赖地图”.
Professional editorial engineering-tool quality: crisp typographic hierarchy, tiny but legible type, disciplined baselines, meaningful whitespace, no heavy shadow, no nested cards, no decorative icon bloat. Palette black/white/grays with blue links and small semantic amber/green states only. Exactly one page, no device bezel. Date if needed uses 2026-11-12. This is candidate workflow UI, do not show fictional pass logs.

images.title: 集成与真实 E2E
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One extraordinarily polished, realistic desktop Fouc page, Chinese, “成员邀请与权限 · 集成验证”, approximately 1600×1000. Show ONE actual software screen, not a collage or poster.
Reference 1 supplies exact Fouc outer shell and small UI density. Preserve it, replace only Dashboard content. Do NOT enlarge shell: sidebar about 250–270px (one sixth of frame), system bar about 44px, 13px normal body and navigation, 12px secondary, title 18px, button 30px. Main work surface white with 16px exterior corner radius. #f9f9f9 shell. No large brand, illustration, metrics or decorative chart.
Shell labels and arrangement exactly as source: project “Fouc 桌面端 V1”, navigation “新对话”, “工作台” active, “任务”, “成员”, “资产”, “智能体”; “频道” with “产品与设计”, “最近”; fixed bottom “社区”, “连接器”, “Fouc Admin”, moon, settings. Neutral gray FA7 solid icons. Top bar history, page tab “集成验证”, plus, search, task and native window controls.
Inside only one 48px toolbar: small integration icon; “成员邀请与权限” followed inline tiny muted “集成验证”; right black “查看运行” and a quiet overflow icon. No breadcrumb, extra tabs, secondary header, KPI cards or stage progress bar. Core begins at y≈96.
Layout: large left working area around 72% of content, right evidence inspector about 28%, separated by one faint vertical line. Precise enterprise-tool typography with normal small text and realistic data, refined gaps and baselines.
Left at top compact label “集成状态” with tiny green “G5 · 合入已确认” on the same baseline. Underneath a dense, continuous three-row table: column labels “交付范围” / “提交” / “确认”; rows “Web 邀请交互” / “a73b9e2” / green “已合入”; “业务服务权限校验” / “c92d104” / green “已合入”; “共享邀请契约 v3” / “ed46f1a” / green “已对齐”. All entries are visual scenario examples. Avoid a large success banner.
Then an extremely compact neutral environment strip “验证环境  ·  staging  ·  2026-11-12 14:32 部署完成”, subtle green dot, document link “部署记录”. This is clearly separate from the integration confirmation. A modest section heading “真实用户旅程” and tiny blue “运行中 · 2 / 4” inline, not a giant numeric statistic.
Show a well-designed continuous list of four user journeys, each around 72px high, with meaningful expected behavior and a small right status: green completed “管理员创建邀请” / “邀请保存为 pending，并返回可访问链接”; green completed “成员接受有效邀请” / “加入当前项目，重复接受不重复创建成员”; selected pale blue running row “过期邀请与重发” / “旧链接失效，管理员重发后新链接可用”; gray queued “撤回邀请后访问” / “撤回后不可加入，界面提供恢复路径”. These are user path tests, not ADD stage steps. Small hollow or solid status circles and delicate separators, no card per row.
Below the journey list, compact section “完成后” with two understated pending action rows: “负责人确认发布范围” and “回写设计与验证索引”. This must not imply a knowledge-base module. No “everything passed” screen: integration can be confirmed while E2E is still running.
Right inspector begins immediately below toolbar. Heading “过期邀请与重发” with tiny blue pill “执行中”. Small metadata rows “环境”/“staging”, “对应版本”/“a73b9e2”, “验证者”/“Tester Agent”. A slim vertically connected evidence trace with timestamps: “14:36:02 打开过期邀请” green check, “14:36:04 确认旧链接不可接受” green check, “14:36:06 管理员重新发送” blue running dot, next “使用新链接加入项目” gray waiting. Then one contained preview surface with a small neutral browser-like capture title “邀请已过期” and two subtle UI controls “联系管理员” / “返回项目”, showing the expected real application recovery moment as a tiny evidence preview, not a second app frame. Below two small document links “浏览器录屏” and “原始验证记录”.
At very bottom of inspector quiet gray text “发布确认等待本次验证结果” and a disabled compact “请求发布确认” button. Show no auto-approve, no generic green overall completion; Gate G5 means integrated and confirmed, E2E proof and release approval remain separate.
Art direction: finely crafted neutral software UI by a leading product studio. Intentional, calm, alive through realistic content, micro states and fine hierarchy. Black/white/grays, tiny purposeful blue/green/amber states, excellent baseline alignment and whitespace. No excessive bold, oversized text, repeated titles, layered cards, heavy shadows, two tiers of tabs, ten sequential stages, giant empty header or garbled Chinese.
